title: Esthetician Concepts
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Esthetician Concepts - Certificate of Achievement - CE961
outcomes: Deduce valid conclusions, compare viable techniques and apply principles in preparation of the California State Board of Barbering and Cosmetology practical and written exam.
Identify and analyze concepts leading to synthesis of theory for the state board written exam. Produce a business plan and portfolio.
Demonstrate entry level skills in a clinic laboratory setting.
Demonstrate workplace behaviors (soft skills) necessary for success in the cosmetology industry.

notes: The page prints three headings at the top (two for 'Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - AS1094/AS1094C/CE1094' and one for 'Certificate of Achievement - CE961') followed by a single description, outcomes list and requirements table. I read the content as belonging to the CE961 certificate, since its 20-unit total fits the 16 to fewer than 30 unit award; a reviewer should confirm the requirements are not those of CE1094.
The program learning outcomes are printed once for the program as a whole; this certificate shares them.
The second outcome is printed as one line containing two sentences ('...state board written exam. Produce a business plan and portfolio.') and is recorded as one entry, as printed.
Course codes are printed with a hyphen (COS-62A1); they match closed-list codes such as COS 62A1.
